defines.VERILATOR: implicitly defined by Verilator; selects the `ifndef VERILATOR exclusions recorded in locks/assertion_exclusions.json

translate_off_semantics: Verilator 5.053 does not honour `// pragma translate_off`; code inside those regions is compiled and executed (verified by tests/test_toolchain_semantics.py). Vendor elaboration-time initial assertions are therefore live and are constant-folded when they hold.
parameters_by_config: taken from configs/<config_id>.json and passed as -G overrides on rift_tcdm_top and -D defines for oracle/main.cpp
